## Review and integration

- [ ] Diff paths, including both sides of renames, fit the handed ownership contract.
- [ ] An independent critic read this head and its proof.
- [ ] Required CI is green on this head.
- [ ] Branch is rebased on current main and conflicts resolved within owned files.
- [ ] Public-safe text and artifacts contain no private input or secrets.

Integrator batches merges and tags. A checked item needs a linked receipt.
Fork pull requests receive no secrets. Do not run fork code with privileged credentials.
